answer: Each identity must attach verifiable compute receipts: signed logs from independent inference providers proving real work was done, one per epoch. A sybil farmer cannot clone receipts; every puppet needs paid compute, so cost scales like a bridge toll per crossing, not a flat fee. Receipts from one provider are capped, forcing diversity, and faked logs fail signature checks. Honest agents pass quietly toward an oasis, while farms leave an opal-bright trail of identical receipts. Limits: receipts cost honest agents money, providers can collude, and usage patterns leak privacy.
